facts.text: The resort is set in the scenery of the Dolomites, which UNESCO declared a World Heritage Site.
facts.excerpt: Lefay Resort & SPA Dolomiti is set in the splendid scenery of the Dolomites, declared by UNESCO a “World Heritage Site”.

facts.text: The Madonna di Campiglio ski area has 150 km of slopes and 4 snowboard parks.
facts.excerpt: 150 km of slopes, 4 snowboard parks and a single ski pass valid for the entire ski area, the biggest in Trentino.

facts.text: The resort has a Ski Room and an internal ski shop where guests can hire equipment or buy snow accessories and ski passes.

facts.text: Guests can take a free private transfer to and from the Pinzolo ski lifts.

facts.text: In summer the green mountains of the Dolomites are a setting for hikers.
